environment: Node 24.22.1, package HTTP handler, ZIP reader, worker and shared care store with local Firestore and private-object fixtures
test: class import creates roster children only in the worker and reuses the source identity across operations
verified: Queue and replay leave the class empty. The worker enrols the verified package child and saves the selected record in the class.
A new operation for the same source reuses the child and record. Two children with the same display name retain separate identities.
Changing the importer's role to viewer before delivery leaves the roster unchanged. The enrolment result records read_only.
The ordinary batch response still uses resolved class and child IDs.
